details:
MISSIONCRAFT – Interactive Space Mission Design Game

MISSIONCRAFT is an interactive educational game that allows players to experience the challenges of designing and planning real-world space missions. The game puts players in the role of space mission designers, assigning them scientific objectives that require them to build and configure suitable spacecraft.

Players select spacecraft components, scientific instruments, and essential systems while managing limited resources such as budget, mass, and power. Each mission introduces different objectives, environmental conditions, and unexpected challenges, requiring players to make strategic decisions and adapt their designs to achieve mission success.

Once the spacecraft is ready, players launch their missions and experience their progress through interactive scenes, unexpected events, and decision-making scenarios that directly influence the mission's outcome.

The main goal of MISSIONCRAFT is to make space science and mission engineering more accessible and engaging, especially for students and young learners. It helps players develop problem-solving, critical thinking, strategic planning, and resource-management skills while introducing them to the complexity of space exploration.

What makes MISSIONCRAFT creative is its combination of educational content and interactive gameplay. Instead of simply presenting scientific information, it allows players to learn through experimentation, decision-making, and experiencing the consequences of their choices.

The project aims to inspire curiosity about space exploration and encourage the next generation to explore careers in science, engineering, and space technology.
